violations.description: Preventing contamination from equipment, utensils, and wiping cloths. — --In-use utensil was not properly stored during pauses in food preparation or dispensing. The handle of the measuring cup in the almonds was stored in the product.

Single-service and single-use articles. — --Single-service item was not stored, handled, dispensed in a manner to protect from contamination. Paper boats on top of the fridge were not inverted or covered.
Single-service and single-use articles. — --Single-service item was not stored in a proper location to be protected from contamination. Boxes of cups were stored on the floor in the storage room.
